1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 c5 5.Nf3.strategy: Develops, guards d4 against the pawn on c5 and prepares castling. White is ready to meet the tension in the centre with pieces rather than pawns.
Adds a second attacker against d4 with a developing move. Black challenges the centre with pieces, and White must keep d4 under control while the long diagonal stays closed by the knight on f3.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 c5 5.Nf3.name: Catalan Opening: Tarrasch Defence
